piece: Cartography, not Tracing / Kartographie statt Kopie — pre-submission enquiry for the ATP process-grammar paper (German original + full English version)
receiver: Journal for Artistic Research (JAR), Society for Artistic Research — Michael Schwab, Editor in Chief
receiver_channel: michael.schwab@jar-online.net (the journal's published editorial contact), alternatively the Submissions field of the contact form at jar-online.net
note: A letter, not a packet. It asks the two questions the journal's public guidelines leave open — whether publication on this site counts as prior publication or as a preprint, and whether a text-dominant exposition of this length is reviewed at all — and it states, rather than asks about, how the work was made: problem, questions, corrections and decisions by its author, drafting by models under his direction, apparatus published. Authorship is not a request. It names unprompted the two Schwab titles the paper has so far verified only bibliographically, one of them the book about JAR's own exposition format, because a list of one's own gaps is the only honest answer to the fair question of whether fast writing means thin reading. Drafted 2026-08-02, rewritten 2026-08-03, unread by Frank and unsent. The full submission waits for the trial in 2026-07-24-put-back-on-the-map to close — that trial is the answer to the paper's thinnest point.
